schema_version: 1
base_path: /internal/v1
auth: exact X-Internal-Token
request_limit_bytes: 1048576
authoring_replay:
  terminal_states: [READY, STAGED]
  create: exact normalized request hash and idempotency key return unchanged stored job
  resume: terminal job returns before new authoring or attempt-cap rejection
  conflicting_request: different normalized request hash remains a conflict
  staging: replay preserves private receipt; public publication remains Practice owned
  dependencies: configured ports remain required; terminal replay does not invoke them
routes:
  - {method: POST, path: /authoring-jobs, idempotency_key: required_uuid, request_union: [tz-planning-request.v1, tz-planning-request.v2]}
  - {method: POST, path: /source-authoring-jobs, idempotency_key: required_uuid, request: tz-source-authoring-request.v1, audience: trusted internal Task Source caller, mode: private only}
  - {method: GET, path: '/authoring-jobs/{id}', response: safe job projection}
  - {method: GET, path: '/authoring-jobs/{id}/technical-task', response: technical-task.v1, availability: READY only, audience: trusted internal consumers}
  - {method: GET, path: '/authoring-jobs/{id}/student-view', response: student-technical-task-view.v1, availability: READY only, audience: student-facing consumers}
  - {method: POST, path: '/authoring-jobs/{id}/resume', response: safe job projection}
  - {method: POST, path: '/authoring-jobs/{id}/stage', response: safe job projection with private staging receipt}
health:
  - {method: GET, path: /internal/health, database_readiness: required}
private_response_forbidden: [private_evaluation, reference fixtures, negative fixtures, code_structure, raw provider output, prompts]
safe_job_orchestration_projection: [schema, trigger, correlation_id, surface_classification, desired_difficulty_level]
student_view_forbidden: [goal, expected_result, concepts, steps, hints, actions, verification, private_evaluation]
outbound_competency_catalog:
  service: ms-go-learning-planner
  discovery_path: /internal/learning-targets/candidates
  verification_path: /internal/learning-targets/resolve
  rule: model selects only from bounded discovery; every selection is exact-resolved
outbound_staging:
  service: ms-go-practice-task-orchestrator
  method: POST
  path: /internal/authoring/v1/task-revisions/stage
  request: practice-task-staging-command.v1
  response: practice-task-staging-receipt.v1
  auth: dedicated LW_PRACTICE_TZ_TOKEN
  idempotency_key: authoring job UUID
  public_revision_created: false
